categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Baosight Software Co., Ltd. primarily operates in software development and engineering services, service outsourcing, and system integration. Its business covers intelligent transportation, intelligent building, mechatronics systems and products manufacturing and sales, public safety and information security engineering, internet data center services, and information services. The company also focuses on industrial software solutions for industries such as steel, non-ferrous metals, chemical, and mining.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including artificial intelligence, industrial internet, big data, edge computing, and cloud computing. It develops proprietary industrial software platforms such as the Baolian platform and autonomous PLC products. It emphasizes full-stack domestic industrial automation products, AI-driven intelligent manufacturing, and robotics, including humanoid robots. The company integrates software and hardware development with system integration and lifecycle services.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are primarily large and medium-sized enterprises in the steel industry, as well as clients in non-ferrous metals, chemical, mining, and urban rail transit sectors. The company serves government entities, industrial enterprises, and technology-driven businesses requiring digital transformation and intelligent manufacturing solutions. It also targets emerging markets such as AI-enabled industrial applications and robotics in manufacturing.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with headquarters in Shanghai and subsidiaries across various provinces including Anhui, Jiangxi, Hebei, Shanxi, and Wuhan. It has overseas subsidiaries in Japan and Italy, with business activities in Europe and Asia. The company is expanding its footprint in strategic regions aligned with national digital infrastructure initiatives such as 'East Data West Computing'.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Baosight Software is positioned primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the industrial digital transformation supply chain. It develops and supplies industrial software, automation control systems, and integrated digital solutions, serving as a technology and service provider to manufacturing enterprises. It also engages in system integration and cloud infrastructure services, supporting end-user digital operations.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes AI-driven innovation, focusing on 'AI+' transformation to enhance industrial intelligence. It invests heavily in R&D for autonomous industrial control systems, large-scale PLCs, industrial internet platforms, and robotics, including humanoid robots. Strategic initiatives include building industry-specific AI models, expanding SaaS service models, and developing national-level computing power centers. The company aims to strengthen self-reliance in core technologies and foster ecosystem collaborations with government, academia, and industry leaders.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through software development and engineering service contracts, service outsourcing agreements, and system integration projects. The company employs a mix of product sales, SaaS subscription services, engineering consulting, and lifecycle maintenance contracts. It also earns income from government subsidies, investment returns, and licensing related to its technology platforms and industrial solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shanghai Baosight Software is a leading domestic industrial software and automation solutions provider, particularly strong in the steel industry. It holds a competitive position supported by national strategic initiatives and certifications. Competitors include other Chinese industrial software firms and automation equipment manufacturers. The company differentiates itself through its comprehensive industrial internet platform, AI integration, and full-stack domestic control systems.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 13.64 billion, representing a 5.64% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 2.27 billion, with a slight decline compared to the previous year. Total assets stood at RMB 21.64 billion, and equity attributable to shareholders was RMB 11.4 billion. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory with significant R&D investment accounting for over 10% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its strategic alignment with national policies on digital infrastructure and industrial modernization. It offers integrated, AI-enabled industrial software and automation solutions that are domestically developed and controllable, addressing critical needs for security and independence in industrial control. Its value proposition includes comprehensive lifecycle services, platform-based solutions, and a strong ecosystem supporting intelligent manufacturing and digital transformation across key heavy industries.
